final: SELECT t.transcript_id, t.transcript_date, t.other_details, c.course_name, c.course_description, s.first_name || ' ' || s.last_name as student_name, s.email_address, s.date_first_registered, dp.degree_summary_name, d.department_name, sem.semester_name FROM Transcripts t JOIN Transcript_Contents tc ON t.transcript_id = tc.transcript_id JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses scc ON tc.student_course_id = scc.student_course_id JOIN Courses c ON scc.course_id = c.course_id JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON scc.student_enrolment_id = se.student_enrolment_id JOIN Students s ON se.student_id = s.student_id JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON se.degree_program_id = dp.degree_program_id JOIN Departments d ON dp.department_id = d.department_id JOIN Semesters sem ON se.semester_id = sem.semester_id WHERE t.transcript_id = 8 ORDER BY s.last_name, c.course_name
